evals.prompt: Fixture: a TypeScript service with a UI repository whose PROJECT.md names docs/architecture.md for the module map, layers, protocol boundaries, and feature registry, docs/spec.md and docs/design.md for behavior and UI rules, and npm test plus node scripts/check-imports.mjs for checks. Work read-only: do not edit files. The PO has approved a new practice mode and the core API already exists. Explain how to add the mode and wire it into the app without the base feature learning about concrete modes.
evals.expected_output: Implement the mode protocol behind a public entry point, register it in the app composition root's feature registry, inject dependencies through protocols with test fakes and the app clock, drive the controller with start/stop, use design tokens, app icon symbols and the string catalog for static labels, and add independent package tests plus a wiring/integration test.
assertions: Wires the mode protocol and feature registry at the app composition root and never imports one feature from another.
Uses the testing module's fakes and the app clock, with controller start() load and stop() cancellation.
Requires independent package tests and a wiring or integration test.

evals.prompt: Fixture: a TypeScript service with a UI repository whose PROJECT.md names docs/architecture.md for the module map and docs/copy.md for UI strings, and defines a string catalog for static labels. The product has user-entered field names and profile names. Work read-only: do not edit files. You are asked to change one button label inside an existing feature. Should you create a new package and follow the add-feature checklist? May user-entered field and profile names go into the string catalog? Answer only.
evals.expected_output: No new package or full add-feature workflow for a label fix; use the existing feature and the string catalog for static labels, and keep user-entered field and profile names as data outside the catalog.
assertions: Does not create a new package or module only to change a label.
Distinguishes static UI labels, which go in the string catalog, from user-entered field and profile names, which stay data.
Does not invoke the add-feature workflow for a small fix inside an existing feature.
